English: Sacred Tree
A lone, ancient tree stands at the heart of the clans new camp, considered sacred and a place for offerings and vows. Elders gather here to reinforce unity and tradition.
Ritual Pavilion
A simple open-air pavilion of poles and animal skins, serving as a gathering place for seasonal rituals and feasts.
Priests Room
A simple private tent for the clans priest, granting him a special place to meditate and store sacred items.
Spirit Hut
A simple grass hut for the clan shaman to commune with the spirits and intercede for the tribe.
Stone Circle
Rough stones are arranged in a circle, marking a place for gatherings, oaths, and the mediation of disputes. The circle channels the old ways.
Ancestor Shrine
A small, makeshift hut is dedicated to honoring the clans ancestors, providing a location for remembrance and guidance.
Diviners Chamber
A small tent for the diviner, where fortunes are cast and omens interpreted for the clans benefit.
Sanctified Grove
A small area of untouched forest is set aside, marked with charms and offerings to the spirits of nature.
Blessed Sanctuary
A modest tent, blessed by the clans priests, offering a place of protection and rest for the faithful.
East African Ritual Grove
A secluded thicket is cleared and marked as a ritual grove, where the clan gathers to honor the spirits of the land and ancestors.
Great Sacred Tree
The sacred tree is now surrounded by a cleared circle, with stones and offerings, drawing the clan together for larger rituals and key decisions.
Decorated Ritual Pavilion
The pavilion is expanded, with colorful banners and symbols, allowing for larger clan gatherings and fostering unity.
Priestly Sanctuary
An enclosed wooden room for the priest, with a small altar and space to receive visitors and offer blessings.
Enlarged Spirit Hut
A larger, sturdier hut for the shaman, supporting more elaborate rituals and attracting seekers from the clan.
Carved Stone Ring
The stones are now carved with sacred motifs, and the ring is used for major clan decisions and fertility rites.
Enclosed Diviners Chamber
A private room for the diviner, with mystical implements and space for secret consultations.
Enclosed Ancestor Shrine
The shrine is rebuilt with wood and clay, decorated with family relics and offerings to draw favor from the spirits.
Blessed Grove
The grove is expanded, with ritual paths and hidden shrines, believed to bring fertility and fortune to the clan.
Sanctified Shelter
A sturdier shelter, bearing holy symbols, where the clan gathers for prayer and reflection.
Expanded Ritual Grove
The grove grows in size and importance, with wooden idols and ceremonial paths for sacred processions.
Hallowed Ancestral Tree
Effigies and tokens of ancestors now hang from the tree, transforming it into a focal point of clan memory and spiritual legitimacy.
Grand Ritual Pavilion
A grand pavilion, richly adorned, where seasonal rites and feasts gather the entire clan and strengthen collective resolve.
Priestly Hall
A permanent structure, the priests hall hosts ceremonies and offers spiritual guidance to the clans leaders.
Spirit Lodge
A well-constructed lodge, adorned with charms and tokens, where the shaman guides the clan and strengthens spiritual bonds.
Harmonized Stone Enclosure
The circle is expanded, with standing stones inscribed to channel the spirits and improve prosperity and unity.
Hall of Ancestors
A large wooden hall houses ancestral symbols and relics, visited by the clan for guidance in times of crisis.
Diviners Hall
A lavish hall for the diviner, where leaders seek counsel and blessings for major undertakings.
Sacred Heart of the Grove
A revered sanctuary among the trees, the grove now hosts major fertility and coming-of-age rituals.
Blessed Sanctuary Hall
A spacious hall for worship and learning, where wisdom and devotion are nurtured in the heart of the clan.
Sanctified Ritual Grove
A revered place now, the grove is used for major clan ceremonies, and its fame draws distant relatives and pilgrims.
Sanctified Grove of Spirits
The area around the sacred tree is now a protected grove, with carved totems and space for grand ceremonies, strengthening unity and piety across the clan.
Sanctified Ritual Pavilion
The pavilion is now a permanent fixture, with sacred artifacts and space for the largest gatherings, cementing clan unity and tradition.
Sanctified Priests Quarters
A grand sanctified building for the priest, serving as a religious court and center for Christian rites among the clan.
Grand Spirit Hall
A grand hall for spiritual affairs, hosting major rituals and attracting respected shamans from afar.
Grand Ritual Stones
Massive stones are aligned for seasonal rites, attracting pilgrims and granting the clan a sacred reputation.
Sanctum of Ancestors
The shrine is transformed into a revered sanctum, with intricate carvings and space for festivals venerating past leaders.
Sanctified Diviners Palace
A magnificent palace for the diviner, serving as a symbol of the clans wisdom and spiritual legitimacy.
Primeval Grove Sanctuary
The grove is transformed into a sacred sanctuary, drawing pilgrims from afar and strengthening the clans spiritual legacy.
Grand Sanctuary of Blessings
A grand sanctuary, richly decorated, serving as a beacon of faith for the clan and visiting dignitaries.
Hallowed Grove of Unity
The grove is transformed into a monumental sacred site, a symbol of clan unity, fertility, and spiritual power for all East African nomads.
